messages:
Ivy: hey team, new WFH selfie — desk + cactus + terrible ring light. pic: https://i.imgur.com/deskCactus.jpg :seedling:
Noah: love the cactus. does the ring light make you hypnotic during standups? :laughing:
Ivy: only when I forget to turn it off. learned that the hard way during a demo. :sweat_smile:
Sasha: PSA \u2014 my ISP had a 7-min dropout at 10:44am. NetBot alerted. switched to tethering and carried on.
NetBot: Outage detected on user subnet 10.4.0.0/24 at 2024-09-04T10:44:07Z. Service restored at 2024-09-04T10:51:15Z.
Liam: quick gear Q: any recs for cheap mic that doesn't pick up treadmill noise?
Noah: Blue Snowball + pop filter did the trick for me. quiet, cheap, solid.
Sasha: also pro tip: put your laptop on a yoga block to raise camera height. instant improvement.
Ivy: poll: who would join a weekly WFH show-and-tell? react :thumbsup: yes, :thumbsdown: nah.
Noah: :thumbsup: count me in. want to see everyone's chair nightmares.
Liam: :thumbsdown: only if there's snacks.
Ivy: noted. will bribe with coffee. thanks for the hotspot help earlier, saved me from missing sprint retro.
